datasets.title: North Korea Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 962.7 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 78% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 4% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information by HOT and compiled into a national dataset for North Korea. AI-based mapping estimates indicate approximately 78% coverage of total buildings. Data quality metrics include average age of 4 years with 4% of features updated in the last 6 months.
